name: EPIC 246280671
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 9.4 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246280671 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.379515 (16th-84th percentiles 9.030207-9.808946), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,342 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.85 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,850 K at its surface.
